ValidationRule.description: Allow to change status to spam without mandatory fields
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), false, AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), NOT(CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'User')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Spam')), ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(ContactId), NOT(ISBLANK(CreatedById)), NOT(CONTAINS($User.Alias, 'ssyst')), NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.ER_Business_Unit__c, 'ES')), NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.ER_Business_Unit__c, 'FI')), NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.ER_Business_Unit__c, 'SE')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the mandatory fields. "Account Name", "Contact Name".
